name: Lakeview Berry Farm
description: Lakeview Berry Farm is a working pumpkin patch in 746 Bergen Rd, WI. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
